More on Education Congressmembers Menefee and Bynum Introduce the All In for Attendance Act to Combat Chronic Absenteeism and Support Student Success June 15, 2026 Press Release WASHINGTON, D.C. — Today, Reps. Christian D. Menefee (TX-18) and Janelle Bynum (OR-05) introduced the All In for Attendance Act, a bill to help schools improve attendance and provide support for students at risk of missing classes. The All In for Attendance Act allows local educational agencies to use federal education funds for evidence-based attendance interventions and student support services to better tackle chronic absenteeism. Issues : Congress Education Rep. Menefee Introduces the College Affordability and Accessibility Act May 5, 2026 Press Release HOUSTON, TEXAS — Congressman Christian D. Menefee (TX-18) introduced the College Affordability and Accessibility Act, legislation aimed at making higher education more affordable and accessible for students across the country by significantly expanding Federal Pell Grant support. The bill would double the maximum Pell Grant to $14,800 per year, with future increases tied to inflation so financial aid keeps pace with the rising cost of tuition, housing, books, and other everyday expenses students face while pursuing a degree. Menefee Statement on ICE Suspending Vehicle Stops July 14, 2026 Press Release WASHINGTON, D.C. — Today, Congressman Christian D. Menefee (TX-18), whose district is adjacent to the Houston neighborhood where ICE agents fatally shot Lorenzo Salgado Araujo one week ago today, issued the following statement after reports that ICE is suspending most vehicle stops following the fatal shootings in Texas and Maine. “A temporary training won’t solve a deeply engrained problem. ICE has been radicalized. Its agents have shot and killed unarmed people across the country. The agency needs to be torn down to the studs. Immigration enforcement shouldn’t be heavily militarized and chasing people through our streets. The American people deserve competent leadership and law enforcement that is transparent, accountable, and worthy of the public’s trust.” Issues : Congress Immigration Media Press Releases Social Media Back to top button

Rep. Menefee Pushes for Nuclear Energy Investments in Houston | Congressman Christian Menefee Skip to main content Rep. Menefee Pushes for Nuclear Energy Investments in Houston September 2, 2026 Press Release WASHINGTON, D.C. — Today, Congressman Christian D. Menefee (TX-18) highlighted Houston’s role in the future of advanced energy during a House Science, Space, and Technology Subcommittee on Energy hearing, “ Powering the Nuclear Renaissance: Accelerating U.S. Leadership in Advanced Nuclear Reactors .” Congressman Menefee focused on bringing more nuclear research, investments, and jobs to Houston as the country works to expand its advanced reactor capacity and meet growing demand for electricity. “Houston is the energy capital of the world. We are a city that builds things, that moves things and that powers things.”  Rep. Menefee said. “When this committee says ‘nuclear renaissance,’ my district hears a job, a career, and an opportunity to research and power what comes next.” Rep. Menefee noted that while Texas has long been a leader in traditional hydrocarbons, nuclear power makes up less than 10% of the state’s electricity generation and has remained roughly flat for decades, even as electricity demand continues to grow. He highlighted the opportunity for Texas to build on its long history of energy leadership by investing in nuclear and other emerging energy technologies. “I want Texas to grow. I want Houston to grow. And I want this nation to grow in this space,”  Rep. Menefee said . “Nuclear energy is the next frontier, and there’s a lot of opportunity ahead. But as we grow this industry, we have to make sure the communities surrounding these facilities aren’t left carrying the burden.
